_meta.note: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 (2026-10-17, MIT): minor update of V4.1-Flash, now served as deepseek-flash. Ingested: the 11-row card/launch table 1017 column (+ HLE text-only), the new Apex Bench v1.1 row for all six columns, official pricing. Tech report PDF is byte-identical to resource/deepseek_v4.1_tech_report_2026-09.pdf (md5 4535b6de…). Not ingested: other comparison columns (= September Table 3, already handled); launch cost chart point positions (only 77.0 is printed; image archived); AA rows shown on the OpenRouter 1017 page are labelled 'DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (Max)' = September checkpoint and already in the DB; OrcaRouter's 45–46 AA projection and Vals 57% expectation are speculation (Vals data module still has V4.1 Flash 51.32 / K3 50.297); BenchLM composite and Kingy's 7-task hosted pilot are not benchmarks.

benchmarks.name: Apex Bench v1.1 (DeepSeek-reported)
benchmarks.description: 'Apex Bench v1.1' as named in the DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 model card / launch table (2026-10-17); DeepSeek gives no metric or harness. Likely Mercor APEX-Agents v1.1, but the values do not match the Mercor board (V4.1-Flash: 64.6 here vs Pass@1 39.5 / mean 50.4 on apex_agents_v1_1_*), so it is kept as its own vendor-reported channel.
